newsitem.title: USA: ALLIANT TECHSYSTEMS TO MOVE OPERATION.
newsitem.headline: ALLIANT TECHSYSTEMS TO MOVE OPERATION.

text.p: Alliant Techsystems Inc said Wednesday its Conventional Munitions Group will move its medium caliber ammunition load, assemble and pack operations from the Joliet Army Ammunition Plant in Wilmington, Ill., to the Radford Army Ammunition Plant in Radford, Va.
The move, which is expected to be completed by mid-1999, will consolidate operations and propellant production into one facility.
Current production contracts at Joliet will be completed by early 1999. The company will continue to bid on new programs that may require load, assemble and pack operations there through mid-1999.
